test_join: test DataFrame.join with left_on, right_on, and maintain_order parameters for inner, left, and full join strategies
test_semi_anti_join: test DataFrame.join with how='semi' and how='anti' to filter rows matching or not matching join keys
test_update: test DataFrame.update method to modify rows matching keys with options for left_on, right_on, how, and include_nulls
test_join_where: test DataFrame.join_where with predicate expressions for inequality and range-based join conditions
test_cross_join: test DataFrame.join with how='cross' to generate Cartesian product of two DataFrames
test_join_filter_pushdown: test lazy join filter pushdown optimization that rewrites full joins to inner joins based on filter predicates
test_join_validation: test DataFrame.join validate parameter to enforce one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-many cardinality constraints
test_join_asof_by_i128: test join_asof with by parameter and Int128 dtype for time-series approximate matching joins
